title: The CyberUnicorn console's Device log copies in one tap

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 in the project thread: 'I cannot copy the log for some reason. Give me a copy button'.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. PREMISE: the Device log at /admin/cyberunicorn was a bare <pre> inside a <details>, and the owner could not select it to paste into a support thread. It now has a Copy log button that copies the same redacted text it shows (signed /c/ links and ?s= signatures cut), via the Clipboard API with a hidden-textarea fallback, and says Copied or Copy blocked.

verify.note: Fails when the Copy button, its fallback, or the redaction of the copied text goes away.
